Commentary.Commentary: Now, then... a huge task awaits the Lankan batters. They were poor in the first Test and need to do a lot better here. Australia, on the other hand, will look to bundle the Lankans out quickly and hope to not bat again. Will that happen? We will have to wait to see.

The Lankan bowling was good to begin with on both the days. They were successful in using the early moisture in the wicket to their advantage but that was that. Once the wicket flattened out, their bowlers looked ineffective. Fernando though was the pick of the lot as he finished with a three-fer but received very little support from the rest.

Travis Head and Joe Burns then stitched a massive 308-run stand. Yes, they did receive reprieves but take nothing away from their knocks. They played aggressively and both scored daddy tons. Kurtis Patterson, who was also dropped on his very first ball, made the most of the chance he got and scored his maiden Test ton. The three hundreds saw Australia post a huge first innings total.

AUSTRALIA HAVE DECLARED! Well, did not see that coming. We thought they would have played a little more. However, a top, top effort by their batsmen as they have posted a huge first innings score. Excellent recovery by them especially after they were rocked early on Day 1. Reeling at 28/3, Sri Lanka would have felt they had a chance to bundle the hosts out for a low score but that was not meant to be.
Comes down the track again, this time though also makes room and hence is able to hit it down to long off for a single.
Skips down the wicket but does not get to the pitch of the ball. Defends it.
Angled into the batsman, Kurtis uses the depth of the crease and then works it to square leg.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Good running! Patterson dances down the track and whips it through mid-wicket. Runs the first one hard, goes for the second and completes it.
Good length again around off, Paine lunges and times it to mid off.
On the fuller side and on the stumps, it is hit down to mid on.
Goes after another one outside off, this time it is hit too close to sweeper cover. A single only.

FOUR! That went to the fence like a tracer bullet! He is playing with some freedom now. Outside off, it is not a full delivery. Patterson throws his bat at it, gets it off the middle and it races to the cover fence.
On the pads, it is worked around the corner for an easy run.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Kasun Rajitha is back on.
Nicely played! Waits for the ball to come to him and then guides it through short third man for a brace.
Steps down the track but Perera shortens his length. It is tapped back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on middle, Paine flicks it to mid on.
Dances down the track and strokes it towards mid off for a quick run. The two have really used their feet well to the spinners.
Now Paine uses his feet and then eases it to long on for a single.
Uses his feet and then works it wide of silly mid on and down towards long on for a single.
Length delivery on off, it is timed to mid off.
On the hip, Kurtis whips it to fine leg for a run. That was an opportunity to get a boundary, Patterson will be disappointed he did not get that away.
Good running! Taps this length ball towards the off side and takes off. The bowler is quick to get to the ball and then has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Short again, Kurtis pulls it again, this time though it is closer to the man at deep square leg. Only a run.
On the shorter side on off, Kurtis pushes it to covers.
On the shorter side, Paine goes back and pulls it all along the ground to the man at deep square leg for a run.
A little too straight in line as Dilruwan spills it on the pads, worked into the leg side by the Aussie skipper for a single.
Full ball in line of the stumps, driven wide of mid off for a brisk single.
Patterson has played it to the point region. No run on offer though.
This full ball is tamely pushed towards mid off.
Short and flat around off, blocked out from the back foot.
Stays right behind the line and defends with a straight bat.
Goes down the ground again, to the other side, and finds the fielder positioned at mid on.
Attacks the stumps with a full length delivery, Paine driven it to mid off.
Remains steady in his crease and then defends solidly.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
On the fuller side of things, outside off, driven to the covers.
No ball! Chamika oversteps again. Full and outside off, driven to the cover area.

Maiden Test hundred for Kurtis Patterson! Well done, lad! Has been a terrific knock so far, made the most of the opportunity given to him. He celebrates, his family in the stands is up in joy. What a moment for the southpaw. He gets there by leaning into the drive and placing it through covers. Takes three runs as the fielder chases it down and stops it with a desperate dive just inside the rope. It's a no ball as well as the bowler overstepped.
Cutting back in from a good length, worked in front of square leg by Paine to bring Patterson back on strike.
Plants his front foot forward and pushes it to the cover area.
Slower through the air, on off, Kurtis is well forward in defense.

In the air and just short! Patterson surely would have had his heart in his mouth for a second. The ball grips and turns as Patterson skips down. It goes off the leading edge and falls short of the cover fielder.
Full and straight, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up delivery from around the wicket, Kurtis plays it towards mid on.
Dilruwan Perera returns to the bowling attack.
Full and well outside off, drilled straight to cover-point.
Straightening off the seam after landing just outside off, Tim Paine meets it with the full face.
Connects well but only a single this time. Pulls it to deep mid-wicket and jogs across to get off strike. Also, the 100-run stand is up between these two as well.
FOUR! Second of the over! Back of a length outside off, Kurtis Patterson offers a firm punch through point and sends it across the boundary line. Just one hit away from his maiden ton.
Full on middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket. No run taken.
FOUR! Patterson welcome the debutant with a boundary. Into the nervous 90s with that hit. Well in control of this shot though. It's short and he pulls it through backward square leg.
Chamika Karunaratne is brought back on.
Quick single taken. The left-hander pushes it on the up wide of mid off and gets to the other end.
Good length ball on the fourth stump line, Kurtis Patterson stands tall and offers a defensive blade in response.
Speared full once again, closer to off this time, driven straight back to the bowler.
FOUR! Too full from Fernando and he pays the price. Lands it outside off, Patterson drives the half-volley through the gap in the covers and finds the fence.
Just sits up for Kurtis as it's pitched a bit short. He rocks back and nails the pull, but finds the man at short mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery which doesn't rise as much, Paine controls the pull as he places it behind square leg. The batsmen cross over.
Positions himself well behind the line and defends it well.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Flighted delivery around off, Paine is well forward in defense.
Short and outside off, cut square through the off side for a single.
Leans ahead into the tossed up delivery and knocks it to long on for one.
The off break around off, Paine plays it with the spin and turns it away on the leg side.
Moving away off the seam, a length ball outside off which keeps low. The southpaw leaves it alone.
Kurtis Patterson has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fraction straight in line, worked down in front of square leg with gentle hands.
Full delivery angling in on off, Kurtis brings a straight bat down in defense.
Seeing the ball land on a length outside off, Patterson lets it through.

Angling down leg once again, shortish delivery, Patterson looks to pull but it goes off the glove. The ball runs down to fine leg where the fielder runs to his left and puts in a good dive. Two runs are taken.
Wide! Short ball down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
Paine plays this quicker delivery back to the bowler and ends the over.
Turning in on middle and leg, worked off the back foot but short leg dives to his left and stops it.
Short and wide outside off, cut through point for an easy single.
FOUR! Taking the attack to the part-timer. This is good batting. Patterson uses his feet, gets close to the pitch and drills it down the ground for a boundary.
A hint of turn away, around off, no shot offered by the left-hander.
Tossed up outside off, from around the wicket, Patterson is well forward as he pushes it square on the off side.
Shortish delivery outside off, Paine rises on his toes and taps it down in front of backward point.
Good length delivery in the off stump channel, left alone.
Banged in short, it's angling in, Paine rides the bounce and controls the pull well. Places it along the turf, towards fine leg, and takes a couple of runs.
Goes full and attacks the stumps, Paine drives it to the man at mid on.
Comes from around the wicket and angles in a length ball on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket by Tim Paine.
Short of a length delivery outside off, angling away, Paine chops it off the bottom half towards covers.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl from the other end.
A single to end as Tim Paine strokes this down to long on.
On the shorter side of things, Kurtis goes back and cuts it behind point. Only a run though, both the batsmen have now opened their account in this session.
Uses his feet and then times it to mid off. Paine sets off for a run, the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Slower through the ait this time, the line is outside leg.
Fires it on the pads again, it is once again clipped to mid-wicket.
Starts off with a full and quick delivery on middle, it is worked to the man at mid-wicket.
We are back for the afternoon session! Kurtis Patterson and Tim Paine will resume their innings. Dhananjaya de Silva will start the proceedings for the visitors. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

Another fine session for Australia. They scored 90 runs for the loss of just 1 wicket. Joe Burns was unfortunate to have missed out on a double ton, but Kurtis Patterson, who went on to score a fifty, and Tim Paine, cruised along without any trouble. The pair has added 70 runs so far. Sri Lanka once again squandered a good start. They got the opener early but couldn't capitalize on it from there. The second session is only going to get better for batting. Going to be another long day in the field for them. Join us on the other side of the break for all the action.
Goes back to bowling length, Patterson negotiates it well. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 2!
NO BALL! But a good surprise bouncer that one! Kurtis evades it at the last moment. The umpire has his one hand stretched sideways as the bowler has overstepped.
Angles it into the pads, Kurtis works it to mid-wicket.
A little bit fuller than the last delivery, the line is similar. Patterson strokes it back to the bowler again.
Corrects his line and bowls it on off, KP defends it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Kurtis misses the flick.
A little too straight, the batter works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Takes a few steps ahead and then works it to mid-wicket.
On the stumps once again, it is blocked out.
Pulls his length back and attacks the stumps, Patterson keeps it out.

FOUR! Beautiful! Excellent placement, that! Makes use of his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and then drives it. It first beats the fielder at short cover and then the dive of the fielder at mid off and into the fence.
Hits it with the angle towards mid on.
Dances down the wicket and works it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side, the batsman goes back and punches it to covers for a run.
FOUR! Hammered! Short and it does not get high enough. Patterson rocks back and pulls it with disdain through mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On the shorter side around off, Kurtis strokes it to covers.
Slightly short and around middle and off, Kurtis flicks it uppishly but well short of mid on.
Fullish and on off, it is hit to covers.
Kasun Rajitha is back on.
Short and flat, spinning in from outside off, Tim is on the back foot as he punches it in the bowler's direction.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and works it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Looped up outside off, pushed to the cover region for one.
Tossed up delivery around off, met with the full face of the bat.
Turning away from outside off, Patterson has nothing to do with it.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Tim Paine closes the face and flicks it to short mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, cut hard square on the off side. Straight to the fielder.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Skips down the track again and pushes it back to Perera.
Spinning in from around off, Paine comes half-forward and blocks it out.
Dances down the track and pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Advances down the track and keeps it out.
This is stroked to mid on but for no runs.
On the stumps, it is kept out.

UPPISH BUT FOUR! Patterson uses his feet, he does not get to the pitch of it but due to the width offered outside off, he goes ahead with the shot. It is uppish but in the gap through covers for a boundary.
A little bit of turn there. On middle and it turns into the batsman. Paine looks to flick but misses, it goes off his pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye is taken.
A single to end as it is worked with the turn towards mid-wicket.
Second time in the over the ball has been played to the fielder at mid on.
Uses his feet again but does not get to the pitch of it, pads it away.
Steps down the track this time and works it to mid on.
Flighted ball on off, Tim pushes it to mid off.
Flatter and around off, Paine lunges and keeps it out.
Another defensive stroke to end the over.
Floats it up on off, Patterson defends it onto the ground.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On middle, Paine goes back and keeps it out.
Good running! Steps down the track and hits it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Edgy runs! Flatter and outside off, Kurtis looks to punch but gets an outside edge through short third man for a couple. Brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
Dhananjaya de Silva is on now.
On the off pole, it is pushed to covers.
Another floated delivery on off, Paine strokes it to mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gives it a little more air but the length is a little too full, the batter pushes it to mid off and gets to the other end.
On middle this time, it is once again defended with ease.
From over the wicket, lands it on leg, wants it to spin away, the ball though goes straight on. Patterson manages to block it with ease.
Well fielded by Karunaratne! It is full and outside off, Paine drives it to the right of the cover fielder. He dives and saves at least a couple for his side.
On the shorter side of things, Paine rocks back and pushes it to point.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full and on the pads, Paine says thank you very much, he keeps good balance and flicks it through mid-wicket. It races away.
Good line and length! Just behind a driving length and lands it around off, Paine keeps it out by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman, it is clipped to mid-wicket.
Outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
He is really using his feet well to the spinner, does so again and manages to flick it to mid on.
Stump-to-stump line, Kurtis lunges and keeps it out.
Charges down the track and works it to mid on. Sets off for a run and completes it.
Flatter on off, it drifts away a little, Paine goes back and keeps it out.
Steps down the wicket and works it to mid on.
FOUR! A good end to the over! An expensive one. 9 from it. Full and outside off, Kurtis at the very end, opens the face of the bat and guides it square on the off side and it races away to the fence.
Full and on middle, Kurtis strokes it past the mid on fielder and collects another brace.
On the shorter side and it is outside off, Paine goes back and punches it. It is in the gap through the cover region and the batsmen take three.
On the off pole, on a length, Paine keeps it out.
Similar line to the last delivery, Paine leaves it alone this time.
BEATEN! Too close to play that shot! It is just outside off, Paine looks to cut but misses. Not a clever shot that, he could have easily chopped it on.
Slower through the air this time, KP lunges and keeps it out.
Fires it into the pads, it is clipped to mid-wicket.
Uses his feet but is unable to get close to the pitch of it, defends it.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Very full on middle, Kurtis plays it across the line to mid on. Since there is no turn, it is not a risky shot.
On the shorter side, Kurtis pushes it to mid off.
Looks to drive it on the up but the ball hits the toe end and goes to the fielder at cover.
Goes full and outside off, Paine creams it but straight to the man at covers.
On the shorter side, Paine goes back and blocks it.
Works it with the angle to the mid-wicket fielder.
On off, defended.

Fifty for Kurtis Patterson, his maiden Test fifty. It has been a very controlled knock from him. Yes, he was given a reprieve when he was on nought but since then, he has looked very fluent and classy. He works this around the corner and takes a run to get to the milestone. He would now want to make it big.
Chamika Karunaratne is back on.
A dot to end as Paine works it to the man at mid-wicket.

Moves onto 49! Makes good use of his feet this time, manages to flick it in the gap in the mid-wicket region. The fielder from mid on runs after it and saves a run for his side as he dives and pushes the ball back in before it crosses the ropes.
Stays in his crease this time, Perera bowls it on the stumps, blocked.
Steps down the wicket for the third ball in a row but is not to the pitch of the delivery again, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Dances down the track once again, gets closer to the ball this time but works it to mid on for no runs.
Uses his feet but the length is short, Kurtis adjusts and defends it out.
Full again on off, TP once again drives it crisply but finds mid off.
Goes fuller in length around off, no swing available. Paine strokes it to mid off.
On the off pole, Paine leans forward and defends it out.
Back of a length on off, Paine goes back and keeps it out.
Back to over the wicket to the left-hander. The ball, however, is on the pads once again. Kurtis flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a run.
Since the swing is now gone, the bowler decides to go around the wicket and angles it into the batter, it is worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
On the stumps once again, Patterson easily defends it.
Uses his feet does the batsman, Perera spots it and bowls it short. Kurtis adjusts and keeps it out.
This is angled into the batsman, KP goes back and whips it but the fielder at short leg comes in the way.
Quicker again and it is bowled on off, Patterson punches it to covers.
Flatter and on off, the batsman goes back and pushes it to mid off.
Floats it up on middle, it is defended.

Drinks! Decent first hour for both sides. Sri Lanka have the all-important wicket of the centurion Joe Burns while Australia have added 47 runs to their overnight total. Seems like whatever the ball was doing early on, has started to fade away. Could be something similar to Day 1.
Hangs on the back foot and meets the ball with a defensive blade in response.
Short delivery into the body, Paine picks up the length early and pulls it with a little swivel behind square leg. The batsmen take two.
Opens the face slightly and dabs it to point. No run taken.
Short of a good length around off, cramping the batsman for room. Tim defends with soft hands.
Bumper on middle and leg, pulls it to fine leg. A single is taken.
Banged in short and angling down, Patterson pulls and misses.
Safe. Patterson drives it towards mid on and sets off. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but Kurtis is in. Replays confirm the same.
Direct hit. Don't think it would matter though, as Patterson seems to have made it in comfortably.
Comes down the track to this floated ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
From around the wicket, it's drifting in on middle and leg, Patterson defends from deep inside the crease.
Spinning in on the pads, nudged square on the leg side for a single.
Another straighter delivery, around off, another defensive shot on offer.
Fuller and straighter outside off, Paine prods forward and keeps it out.
Dilruwan Perera to have a go with the ball.
Fuller length delivery, curling in on middle and leg, Tim attempts to flick but misses. It goes off his pads on the leg side and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Some room for Paine to work with. It's a bit short, so he cuts it through point for a brace.
Seeing the ball go well across, the batter lets it go.
Back of a length around off, kept out from the back foot.
Beaten! Angling across, on a good length, Paine pokes inside the line and gets beaten.
FOUR! Beautiful. He's looking in good touch already. Full delivery just outside off, Paine leans into the drive and caresses it through mid off for a boundary.
Vishwa Fernando back on to bowl.
Once again it's well outside off, Kurtis Patterson watchfully lets it go past him.
Served too far outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Shot. Bumper on middle and leg, Patterson swivels and pulls it through fine leg for a boundary.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Going away from the batsman, around off, defended.
No ball! Outside off and it's left alone. No ball signalled as the bowler overstepped.
Rajitha has gone off the field for the time being as he seems to have injured his finger.
Angling across from a good length, Kurtis defends it from within his crease.
Fullish in length and outside off, pushed defensively to the cover region.
Stays right behind the line to this one and blocks it out.
Moving away off the seam, a length ball around off, it's patted down in front of point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! A little bit of width on offer and Paine latches on to it quickly. Short and wide outside off, the Australian captain cuts it fiercely through point for a boundary.
Behind a good length, around off, kept out from the back foot.
Lovely timing on that from Paine. He leans into the full ball and pushes it nicely past mid off. It won't go all the way, but it's enough to fetch him three runs. Chandimal does the chasing work.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, driven to mid on. Dot ball.
Needs to bring it in closer. A length delivery outside off, the Aussie skipper lets it go.
Too far outside off, Paine goes after it but fails to connect.
Good length ball outside the line of off stump, Tim Paine lets it through.
First change of the morning. Chamika Karunaratne is into the attack.
Full delivery aiming the top of off stump, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Switches the angle to around the wicket and bangs it in short outside off. It angles in as Patterson looks to punch it on the off side. Gets an inside edge instead which thuds onto his pads.
A little too straight in line, it's nudged fine down the leg side. A couple of runs are easily collected.
Outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Throws it down the leg side, the southpaw looks to flick but misses.
Short of a good length on middle and off, Kurtis stays back to block but is caught on the thigh pad.
Served across the batsman, on a length, he doesn't play at it.
Keeps a little low, around off and moving away, Paine plays away from his body and gets it off the outer half towards gully on the bounce.
Ahead of a good length, around off, defended in front of covers by coming ahead.

Roaring appeal from Fernando, but it's shut down. Pitching outside leg and Chandimal probably knows that. Hence, doesn't opt for the review when Fernando looks towards him. Full ball which catches Paine on the pads, in front of the stumps, as he misses his flick. Nothing doing though.
Fraction straight in line, worked off the inner half to square leg for one.
Back of a length around off, Patterson defends from inside the crease.
Good length delivery around off, Tim Paine comes half-forward and blocks it well.
Skipper Tim Paine walks in next.

OUT! Dragged on! How unfortunate. Of all the ways he could have gotten out. Joe Burns walks back dejected as he misses out on a double ton, but the crowd gives him a standing ovation. What a knock. Length delivery around off, Burns loosely plays at it and gets a big inside edge which crashes back into the stumps. A well-deserved wicket for Rajitha and Sri Lanka. This is just the start they'd have hoped for today.
Fuller on off stump, pushed back down the track.
FOUR! Too full and too straight, easy enough for Joe Burns to flick it through the mid-wicket region. He gets his first boundary of the morning.
Full on the pads, flicked down to fine leg for a single.

No ball and FOUR! Short ball and it's pulled away. Don't want to bowl it to Patterson there. He rocks onto the back foot quickly and hits it over mid-wicket for a boundary. No ball signalled as well as the bowler overstepped his line.
Full delivery around off, pushed towards mid off without much power.
Beaten! Good shape on that. A little fuller, around off and moving away late, Joe looks to drive down the ground but misses.
Short and wide, Joe cuts it through cover-point and manages to come back for the second.
Positions himself well behind the line and blocks it rather comfortably.
Too wide outside off, no chance Joe Burns bothers himself with that.
Fuller from Fernando on this occasion, blocked down the track with the full face.
Good length delivery just around off, not much movement on it, Burns defends it with soft hands on the off side.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Outside off on a good length, no shot offered by the batsman.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Going away from around off, a length delivery which rises off the deck. Patterson cuts it past the diving gully fielder for a boundary.
Angling across from a good length, Patterson meets it with a straight bat in response.
Short of a good length into the body, Joe flicks it to the square leg area for a single.
Good length delivery around off, making the batsman play, Burns defends it from inside the crease.
Served on a length, on the fifth stump line, left alone.
Brings it in closer, a length ball around off, worked in front of square leg off the inner half.
Fourth leave in a row. Patterson isn't bothering himself with the deliveries which are outside off.
Too far outside off, easy leave for the batsman.
Angles in and then leaves the batsman, Kurtis lets it be.
On the fuller side of the length, outside the line of off stump, arms are shouldered.
Short of a good length around off, moving away off the seam, defended down under his nose.
Further outside off on this occasion, Joe Burns makes another leave.
Hurled outside off, left alone by Joe.
Beaten! Absolute peach from Rajitha. Lands it around off, it comes in and then shapes away late. Burns is squared up a bit as he looks to defend. The ball whiskers past the outside edge.
Quite full and coming back in on off, driven past the bowler, towards mid off and the batsmen take a single.
Just ahead of a length, close to off, Kurtis defends it from inside his crease.
Kasun Rajitha will bowl from the other end.
Angling across from a good length, outside off, tapped down on the off side with an open face.
Full in length, outside off, pushed to the cover area for a quick single. Both batsmen open their account for the day.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Wasn't far away from the off stump. Cuts back in from a good length, Patterson shoulders arms. He probably didn't expect it to come in so much though.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, shapes away a bit, Patterson lets it be.
Goes full and swings it in on middle and leg, Burns looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads. It rolls to square leg and a single is taken.

We are ready to begin. The overnight batsmen, Joe Burns and Kurtis Patterson, walk out to the middle. Vishwa Fernando will take the ball, which is relatively new, first up. Two slips and a gully in place.

Welcome for the second day from the Manuka Oval. The opening day was one which all Australian fans must have been craving for. The Lankan bowling attack did threaten to bring the hosts' worst nightmares to reality, but Joe Burns and Travis Head put all fears to rest. The entire day belonged to them. They scored 308 runs between them. Burns scored his fourth Test hundred and the first of the Australian summer, while Head got to his maiden Test ton. There's a big score on the board already and one can only think of the worst for the Lions. Let's see how it plays out.
... Day 2, Morning Session ...

The Lankans are staring down the barrel of a big first innings total, unless they pick up a couple of quick wickets early on Day 2. Those multiple dropped chance have surely haunted them already, but could cause further damage still. Could be a long day for the visiting side. Will we see Australia broaden their dominance? Join us at 1030 local (2330 GMT, previous day) for all the action. See you then!

Fernando's double strike and debutant Karunaratne took the top order apart, but Burns and Head saw out the tricky period under overcast conditions and took control of things in the second session. Sri Lanka's inexperience in attack showed and they couldn't control the run flow. Even Dilruwan got taken apart. The Burns-Head duo added a record 308 runs, thereby handing the day to the hosts without question.

It would have appeared that Australia would be stuck between a rock and a hard place after that shaky start, but two heroes in the form of Joe Burns and Travis Head arose to bail their team out of what could have been an embarrassment. The Australians had have a tough summer, but this will surely give them something to smile about.
Darts this on middle, Patterson defends it from within his crease. THAT IS STUMPS ON DAY 1. AUSTRALIA END WITH 384/4.
FOUR! Misfield and a boundary. Flighted ball around off, Patterson takes it on the full and drives it towards covers. A misfield there and the ball runs to the fence.
Bowls this quicker on off, Patterson gives it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, Kurtis bunts it down.
Full in line of the stumps, Patterson is solid in his defense.
Quicker one on middle and leg, Patterson plays it towards mid on.
Dilruwan Perera to possibly bowl the last over of the match.
Length ball on off, Patterson gets it past the off side and takes one.
On his pads, Patterson turns his bat to the on side.
Outside off, Patterson defends it off his back foot.
Outside off, Patterson watches it go through to the keeper.
Full again on middle, eased away through square leg for one.
Fuller ball on off, Burns drives it to mid off.
Another ball outside off, Patterson has an easy leave.
Closer to the stumps, Patterson gets behind it and blocks it.
Outside off, Patterson leaves it alone.
SIX! Pulls and pulls really well. Enormous shot. Short ball on middle and leg. Patterson waits for it and pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Similar length and line, this time Burns taps it wide of short mid-wicket and hares to complete the run. This is now his highest Test score.
Length ball on middle and leg, Burns taps it near the bowler. Dot ball.
Full and outside off, Patterson offers no shot to it.
Full and on off, moves away a bit. Patterson gets behind it but drives it to cover-point.
Full on middle and leg, pushed to the man at mid on and gets to the other end.
Closer to the stumps, Joe pushes it to the cover region.
Length outside off, Burns chooses to leave it alone.
Full outside off, Burns drives it to the man at mid off.
PEACH! Beauty from Rajitha. Serves this on a good length around off, Patterson offers a straight bat but gets beaten.
Outside off, Patterson shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full on middle and leg, played to the mid-wicket region for one.

FOUR! Top class batting. Not afraid to go after the new ball. Similar line and length. Burns stays inside, strides ahead and creams this through the same region. The fielder goes to the boundary only to retrieve the ball back.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Doesn't move a bit. Overpitched around off, Burns drives it through covers and doesn't bother running. Boundary.
Fuller ball on the off stump line, Joe plays it with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Where is the patience? He left three balls outside off and now goes after one. Well wide outside off, Patterson still goes after it and almost gets an outside edge back to the keeper.
Full and wide. KP doesn't bother playing at it.
Outside off again, too far to make Patterson play.
Full outside off, easy leave for Patterson.
Angles this full into the legs of Kurtis. Patterson gets behind it and flicks it through mid-wicket. The square leg fielder runs to his right and keeps it to two.
Slower ball but well outside off. Patterson thinks of playing at it but then leaves it alone.
Vishwa Fernando returns to the attack.
Full pitched ball on middle and leg, Burns turns his bat to short mid-wicket. One run off the first over with the new ball.
Another ball pitched up on that fourth stump channel. Burns drives it but for the man at covers to collect.
Yorker in line of the stumps. Burns does well to put bat on that.
Full and tailing into Burns. He misses his flick and gets hit down the leg side on his pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire stays unmoved.
Fuller ball, this one moves in the air. Patterson turns it to the on side. Single taken.
Pitches it up in search of swing outside off. Not much movement. Patterson guides it to backward point.
The second new ball is available now. And taken as well. The fact that Fernando needed to stretch out his hamstring gave the team enough time and incentive to go for it quickly.
Full on middle and leg, Patterson comes down the track and eases it to long on to keep strike for the next over.
Over the off pole, Patterson goes back and pushes this to the man at cover-point.
Patterson takes this on the full and drives it to the man at mid off. Dot ball.
Wide outside off, cut away to the man at backward point.
Short again on off, played back to the bowler.
Short ball outside off, Patterson goes back and cuts it but finds the fielder at covers.
Floats it on middle, Burns blocks it out.
Stump-to-stump line, the batsman is solid in defense.
On middle, it is kept out.
Good use of the wrists there! It is on the stumps, Burns moves away and then guides it behind point for a couple.
Comes down the track, strokes it to mid on and takes a quick run.
Flatter and on the stumps, blocked.
Dilruwan Perera is back on.
Covers his stumps, and stonewalls this.
Burns gets behind this one and blocks it out.
Strays on the pads again, Patterson clips it in front of square for a single.
Darts this on off, Burns pushes it through mid off and rotates strike.
On the pads again, turned to the on side.
Flighted ball on middle, Patterson flicks it through mid on and jogs to complete the run.
FOUR! Pitched up outside off, Joe gets to the pitch of it and creams it through covers. The second one of the over.
Outside off, Burns inside his crease blocks it out.
Corrects his length on the leg side. Patterson flicks it through square leg and gets to the other end.
FOUR! First for Patterson. Another back of a length ball around off. Kurtis waits for it and punches another one through cover-point for a boundary.
Outside off, Patterson stands tall and blocks it out.
Played to the point region by Burns. They pick up a single.
Debutant Chamika Karunaratne brought back.
Tossed up on off, Burns pushes it off his back foot and gets one.
Kurtis works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full in line, Patterson plays it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Patterson goes back and pushes it to the off side.
Full on middle, Patterson flicks it to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball around off, Patterson uses his feet and plays this on the on side.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Burns gets his front leg forward and plays it towards mid-wicket.
Pushed to the cover region by Patterson. The batsmen have run through for a single. Kurtis is off the mark.
Short ball outside off, Patterson sways away from it.
Pitches this up further on the pads, Burns flicks it away through square leg for one.
Back of a length on middle and leg. Burns looks to tuck it away but misses it. The ball goes on and hits him high on the pads.
Length ball outside off, Burns leaves it alone.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

DROPPED! Sri Lanka are just not in the mood to catch the ball today. This one is a sitter. The straighter one by Dhananjaya on middle, Kurtis Patterson plays outside the line. The ball goes off the inner half, onto the pads and then lobs to short leg. Thirimanne there tries to grab it but spills it. Went at it with hard hands. A life off the first ball for Kurits. Can he make most of the chance like Head and Burns?
150 for Burns as he drops it towards point for a quick run.
Fired on the leg stump, it is defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter and on the pads, it is worked to square leg.
Kurtis Patterson comes out to bat.

OUT! PLUMB! That's it. The partnership is finally broken. 308 runs added by these two. What a knock from Head. Came in at a tough time and steadied the ship. Fernando comes in from round the wicket and lands this on a length on middle and leg. Head misses his flick and gets rapped on his pads. After an appeal, the umpire doesn't hesitate to raise his finger. Travis has a chat with his partner and walks. Can Sri Lanka capitalize on this?
Wide down leg, Head covers his stumps and leaves it alone.
Bouncer! Travis ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Short ball on off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Head goes back and pushes it through covers. They cross.
FOUR! Nothing seems to stop them from scoring. Back of a length ball around off, head stays inside and punches this back past the bowler for a boundary.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
The batsman drives this through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Dropped! A sharp chance but once again it should have been taken! Head comes down the track again and smashes it uppishly towards the bowler, he gets two hands to it but spills it. He maybe could not react in time. Another life for Head.
FOUR! In the gap! Dances down the track, takes it on the full and hits it away from short mid-wicket and also the fielder in the deep.  A boundary.
On the pads again, Head looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Flighted ball on the pads, it is clipped around the corner for a run.

Drinks break. Australia scoring runs freely, too freely in fact. The rub of the green is going their way too and it seems like there isn't anything Sri Lanka can do about it. They seem clueless as to how to break this partnership. More of the same to follow in this final hour? Or will something change?
Angles it down the leg side, the batsman has no trouble leaving it alone.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short, wide called.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, worked with the angle down to fine leg for one.

FOUR! Edged, short and through the fielder as well. Everything going Australia's way today. Short of a length outside off, Burns cuts and gets an edge. It falls short of Mendis at slip and goes through him for a boundary.
Once again it's outside the line of off stump Joe Burns lets it be.
Outside off on a good length, left alone.
Full ball on off stump, driven wide of mid off for a single.
Uses his feet and milks it through mid on for one. That's 150 for Travis Head.
Over the off pole. Head punches this towards long off and takes a run.
Joe has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Camps back and punches this through covers to get to the other end.

NOT OUT! Head survives. A bit short, closer to the stumps, Head still tries to cut it. He gets a bottom edge and the ball bounces off his shoe and lobs towards Mendis at first slip. Kusal dives forward and takes it with one hand. Sri Lanka celebrate. The umpires have a chat and give the soft signal as out. However, replays show us that the ball touched the ground before settling into the hands of Mendis. The visitors' celebration is short lived.
Could Sri Lanka finally have a breakthrough? Is Travis Head gone? The soft signal is out. Let's see...
Short ball outside off, Head cuts but finds the man at backward point.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Errs down leg, Head covers his stumps and leaves it alone.
Fernando bangs it short, Head goes for the hook but doesn't make any contact.
Fuller on the pads, Travis flicks it off his pads.
Wide! An attempted bouncer which is well over head height. Travis leaves it alone. Wide given by the umpire.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Head rocks back and cuts this through point. The fielders in the deep are wide and cannot get close to it. Boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Head punches it through cover-point. The ball doesn't go all the way but enough to get two.
Defended off the front foot by Burns presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Outside off, Head gets it past the infield on the off side and takes two.
The batsman plays the square cut. They pick up a single.
Fraction short outside off, Head pushes it towards the mid off region and collects one.
Loopy ball on middle, Head bunts it down.
Outside off, Head punches it through covers for a single.
300 up for Australia. Full on leg, Burns flicks it with a wristy shot and gets one for it.
Outside off a bit on the shorter side. Head punches it through the off side and gets to the other end.
Wide! Another attempted bouncer and Head tries playing a similar cut. He misses but the umpire deems it as a wide.
Short ball outside off, Head tries to play the upper cut but fails to make any contact.
Hit hard. Fuller ball again outside off. Head drives but finds the man at mid off.
FOUR! The runs are coming quick. Full and wide outside off, Head strides forward and drives this with ease through cover-point. A boundary results.
Joe Burns works this full ball towards mid on and takes off. There is a throw at the striker's end which misses and the fielder backing up can't do it properly. So, the batsmen steal an extra run.
Vishwa Fernando is brought back.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy and full on leg stump, Joe clears his front leg and pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Makes room and eases this tossed up delivery to mid off. One run to the total.
Spinning in on middle and leg, flicked wide of the square leg fielder for a run.

FOUR! From around the wicket, it's pitched across outside off, Burns camps back and cracks it through the covers for a boundary. This is now the highest partnership for Australia against Sri Lanka for any wicket.
Dhananjaya de Silva to roll his arm over.
FOUR! Ends the over in fine style. Travis Head waits for the short ball to come, plays it late and upper cuts it over the slip cordon for a boundary. 12 runs from this one. 27 from the last two.
Short ball which is pulled away through mid-wicket. There is protection in the deep so the batsmen only get one run.
Too straight in line, it's worked off the hips down to fine leg for a run.
Full delivery well outside off, shaping away, Joe reaches out to it and creams it through cover-point. Deep point moves to his right and stops it. Single to the total.

FOUR! Beautiful. The debutant goes too full, fires it on off, Burns plants his front foot forward and drives it through the covers for a boundary. The partnership between these two reaches 250. Doesn't look like anything is going to stop them any time soon.
Back of a length outside off, worked into the leg side for one.
Out of the crease again as he pushes it to mid off. A single is taken. 15 runs from this over.
FOUR! Turning to be an expensive over. The offie provides too much width outside off, Travis Head shifts his weight on the back foot and cuts it fiercely through point for a boundary.
SIX! Right off the meat! That's a very good shot from Travis Head. Puts Dilruwan under pressure by using his feet. Gets close to the pitch and smokes it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out without any problem.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
In the air and just wide! Wasn't far away at all. Head skips down the track and flicks it uppishly just wide of the diving short mid-wicket fielder. Three runs are taken.
Skidding off the deck a bit, a length ball on off, Burns looks to block but is caught on the pads. Maybe an inside edge on that?
Shortish and well outside off, Head cuts it square, through the gap and crosses over.
Short of a good length outside off, Burns places the punch wide of cover for one.
Angling in on middle and off, the batter moves inside the line and defends it to the leg side.
FOUR! All too easy for this pair at the moment. Joe Burns leans into this full delivery and drives it through the covers for a boundary.
Full length delivery targeting the off stump, blocked.
A touch straight in line, worked away off the pads for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Good use of the feet from Burns. He jumps out to this length ball and flicks it neatly through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off stump, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Stays right behind the line and blocks it out safely.
Joe Burns has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on to end the over.

Edged but short. Outside off, rising off the deck from a back of a length. Head is taken by surprise and it goes off the edge behind. Mendis at first slip dives to his left, a little forward but it falls just short.
Leans into the full ball and drives it to mid off.
Short of a good length, around off, blocked from the back foot once more.
Short of a length outside off, kept out off the back foot.
FOUR! Full delivery aiming the base of off stump, Head drives it through the vacant mid on region and finds the fence.
Similar ball, similar delivery. Solidly kept out.
Loopy and full, attacking the stumps, forces Joe Burns to press forward and dead-bat it.
Comes forward to this full ball and defends.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and flat outside off, punched square through the off side for a brace.

FOUR! Maiden Test hundred for Travis Head! Australia, after having gone almost the entire summer without anyone getting to the triple-figure mark, have two in a single game. When it rain it pours, eh? He gets to the milestone by leaning forward and driving it through mid off for a boundary. Travis takes his helmet off, celebrates and acknowledges the support from the crowd after kissing the emblem on his helmet. It was a long time coming, he's done it today finally.
Ahead of a good length, around off, defends it by coming half-forward.
Hurls it down the leg side, Joe lets it go.
Switches to around the wicket and angles in a length ball on middle, Head uses the angle and works it to deep square leg. Moves to 98 with a single.
A bit slower in pace, a back of a length ball on the stumps, Head is on his toes as he whips it to mid-wicket.
Banged in short, the batter has nothing to do with it.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to point for a single.
No ball! A false start from the pacer. Length delivery around off, blocked by Burns comfortably.
Flat and short on off, punched back to the bowler off the back foot.
Sliding in on middle and leg, the southpaw goes deep inside the crease and flicks it on the leg side.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Travis Head rocks back and cuts it off the outer half down to third man. A boundary results.
Meets the flatter ball with the full face of the bat.
The 200-run partnership is up with this. Burns moves inside the line and tickles it fine down the leg side. The batsmen take three. They are going along without any problem whatsoever.
Straighter one around off, shorter in length, Burns moves inside the line and works it down on the leg side.
Stays inside the crease and keeps it out off the back foot.
Full outside off, Head leans into it and drives it sweetly to the covers. Dhananjaya there dives to his left and stops it.
Short of a length around off, angling across, the punch is forced on the off side.
Banged in short but down the leg side, Travis ducks and lets it sail over his head.
Full in length, seaming away from around off, driven towards mid off where Chandimal makes a diving stop.
Too far outside off, the batsman lets it be.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes deep inside the crease, plays with the spin and turns it to the leg side.
The off break around off, turning in, defended by coming well forward.
Over the wicket to Burns. Fuller on the pads, worked to the leg side. Dot ball.
Comes out again and pushes it wide of mid off. A quick single is taken.
Floats it up from around the wicket, Head gives the charge and hits it back to the bowler.
Dilruwan Perera will bowl from the other end.
Good length delivery outside the line of off stump, dabbed with an open face to point.
Drives this full ball to the mid on area. Won't get any run for it though.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Burns slashes hard at it. Places it behind point off the outer half and gets a boundary to his name.
Touch straight in line, flicked to the man in front of square leg.
Cutting back in from a good length, worked off the pads for a single.
Length delivery outside off, left alone.
We are back for the final session of the day. Joe Burns and Travis Head to continue. Kasun Rajitha will start off with the ball. Let's go...
... Day 1, Session 3 ...

Do I even need to mention who this session belongs to? It is not only a wicket-less session for them but they have also scored at a very brisk rate. They entered this session in a spot of bother but ended it in a commanding position. Head and Burns have added 192 runs with the latter scoring a ton and the former nearing one. The left-hander has had luck on his side as he was given a reprieve but take nothing away from his knock. Australia will hope the two continue. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, will need a few quick wickets or they will be staring down a big first innings score.
Burns strides forward and bunts this one to end this session. TEA, DAY 1.
Outside off, Burns punches this through covers. They run the first one hard and mange to somehow get back for the second. Head looked slow but the throw from the deep helped him.
Darts this full on middle, flicked to short mid-wicket.
On the legs of Burns who plays it towards mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, Head paddles it fine and the ball towards fine leg. They come back for the third.
Head has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Short, wide and put away! It sits up to be hit, Burns slaps it through covers and it races to the fence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

EDGED BUT DROPPED! That was there for the taking! Yes, it did go to him quickly but that should have been taken. Slightly short and outside off, Head goes for a half-hearted cut shot. The ball flies off the outside edge towards Dilruwan at gully. He tries to take it with two hands but the ball bursts through and goes down towards backward point for a run. 87 almost proved to be unlucky for Head. Sri Lanka needed that to be taken as they needed a wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, Head tries cutting it but gets beaten by the extra bounce.
Off spinner on middle and leg, turned to the on side for nothing.
Loopy ball on off, Burns pushes it to the off side.
Full on the pads, flicked away through square leg for one more.
A bit short on off, Burns punches it towards mid off and gets one.
Similar line, Burns get to the ball and defends another one.
Fuller on off, Burns blocks it.

Wants a quick single and he gets it! 100 for Burns, his 4th and Australia's first this summer in Tests. A very delightful knock this one, very pleasing to the eye. He was cautious at the start when the Lankan bowlers were doing well but then got into his own and started dictating terms. He drops this towards point and takes a single to get to the milestone. Takes his helmet off, kisses it and raises the bat to soak in the applause by the crowd. He would now want to make it a really big one and make a massive statement.
On middle, Burns strokes it to mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Burns strokes it crisply but to the man at covers.
FOUR! Onto 99! Short and bounces at a good height for the batsman. Burns rocks back and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
On the pads, Burns misses the flick and gets hit on the pads.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
A little too straight on middle, it is worked through wide mid on for a couple. The bowler has overstepped so it has been signaled as a no ball.
Kasun Rajitha is back on.
Around off, Head defends it off his front foot.
In line of the stumps, Travis stonewalls it.
FOUR! Outside off, Head rocks back and cuts it through point. The ball races away to the fence and the 200 is up for the home team.
On the pads, Head turns it to the leg side.
Back of a length over the stumps. Head punches it back to the bowler.
Head gets behind the ball and blocks it out.
OHHHH! Just outside off and it is flatter, Burns tries to play it late but gets beaten.
Flatter and on off, Burns goes back and keeps it out.
On the pads, it is clipped to mid-wicket.
Uses his feet and flicks it through square leg for a run.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Flighted ball on off, it is defended.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Tosses it above the eye line, Burns strokes it back to the bowler.
Hesitation but safe in the end! Short and outside off, Head chops it towards covers. The batsmen first set off for a run, both hesitate but then eventually go for it and make it.
Slightly shorter but it is too close to the off pole, Head cuts it to point.
Flighted ball outside off, Head makes a leave.
On the pads, it is flicked through square leg for a single.
A little too straight, it is tucked around the corner for a single.
Slower through the air on middle, it is worked with the turn to mid-wicket.
On off, Burns pushes it to covers.
Works it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This time he is pretty sure he wants to play it off the back foot as it is a short ball. Head goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Flatter and on a decent length, Head first is not sure whether to play it off the back foot or the front. He ends up defending it by staying rooted to his crease.
Dilruwan Perera is back on.
Works it against the angle to the man at mid-wicket. A dot to end the over.
On the shorter side, Head goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side, Head goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
Flatter and on middle, Burns drops it towards cover for a single.
Slower through the air on middle, it is defended back to the bowler.
Makes use of the feet once again and drives it a little wide of mid off for a run.
Looks to drag his pull from outside off, hits it well but finds the man at square leg.
Attacks the off stump again, JB defends it onto the ground.
On off, Burns is solid in defense.
Slightly fuller in length on off, Burns strokes it to mid off.
Into the 90s is Burns. Full and outside off, it is stroked square on the off side. The fielder in the deep does well to slide and keep it down to two.
Length delivery, it is angled away. Burns shuffles across and keeps it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the ball, he pads it away.
Angles this one into the off pole, Head goes back and cuts it to point.
Gets of 87 with a sweep shot towards deep square leg. A single.
On the stumps, Burns lunges and keeps it out.
Slightly short and on off, Head punches it through covers for a run.
Keeps strike for the next over by guiding it through point. 14 from the over, an expensive one.

FOUR! Third boundary in the over and it is the best of the lot. Head joins the party. Slightly fuller in length and on off, Head takes his front foot towards the pitch of the delivery, leans into the stroke and then times it through extra cover.
Short and it is down the leg side, Head evades it.
On the shorter side of things, it is cut through point for a single.

FOUR! This time though the second ball too goes for a boundary. This is better than the last one. Full and outside off, Burns caresses it through covers and you need not run for those. 14 away from a century now.

FOUR! Cracked away! Too easy for Burns at the moment. Slightly short, he picks he length early, Burns swivels and pulls it through backward square leg. Once again Fernando's over starts with a boundary.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On the stumps, Head keeps it out.
This time gets to the pitch of the ball and then strokes it to covers.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Flatter and around middle, Head pushes it to mid on.
Dances down the track, does not get to the pitch of it and keeps it out.
From around the wicket, it is angled into the batsman. Burns stays back and defends it onto the ground.
On the shorter side again, angles it into the batsman. Head pushes it through mid on and the batter takes three.
Back of a length on off, Head pushes it to mid off.
Better line and length this time! On off and on a length, it is kept out.
Another shorter delivery outside off, Burns guides it through point for a single.
FOUR! That has been hit with disdain! Short and it sits up to be hit. Bruns goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Vishwa Fernando is back on.
Slower through the air on middle, it is driven back to the bowler.
Extremely full outside off, Head jams it out towards covers.
Uses his feet again and strokes it back to the bowler.
Fires it on off, Head goes back and pushes it to covers.
Uses his feet and strokes it to mid on.
Flatter and on middle, Head pushes it to mid on.

Drinks break. As expected, Burns and Head have done well to take full advantage of the conditions on offer. 55 runs have been scored in this hour and they don't look like stopping. Sri Lanka need to, at the very least, control the run flow for the moment. Big hour ahead of them. Also, Dhananjaya de Silva is brought into the bowling attack.
Travis stays leg side, steps out and drives it past short extra cover, towards mid off, and takes a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Quicker through the air, around off, kept out from inside the crease.
FOUR! Takes the aerial route and gets the desired result. This is a well controlled shot. Joe Burns gives the charge, gets close to the pitch and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Loopy and full on middle and leg, blocked by coming well forward.
Quicker delivery darted across, pushed into the off side.
Length ball on the stumps, it goes off the inner portion and away on the leg side.

Incredible save from Kusal Perera. Stops a certain boundary. Joe Burns hammers this to the covers off the front foot, but Perera there dives full stretch to his right and stops it. Only a single taken.
No ball! For overstepping. Fuller outside off, Burns hits it hard through the covers. Rajitha out in the deep moves to his right and dives to make a good stop. Two runs taken.
Hangs on the back foot and keeps it out safely.
Fuller and outside off, Joe Burns looks to drive but fails to make connection.
Back of a length on middle and off, Travis moves inside the line and works it front of square on the leg side. Single taken.
FOUR! Shot. All about the timing on that. Length delivery around off, Head offers a firm punch down the ground and sends it across the boundary line.
Dabs this in front of covers. Wants the single but then decides against it.
FOUR! Flatter ball outside off, Burns moves across his stumps and crashes it through the gap in the covers. Once it's past the infield, the fielders have no chance to stop it.
Short, flat and around off, Head pats it wide of cover and gets to the other end.
Not much spin on this occasion, around off. Travis defends it from within his crease.
Jumps out of the crease to this floated ball and hits it back down the track.
Turning away from around off, left alone by the batsman.
Jags back in, from a good length, takes the inside edge and thuds onto the batsman's pads.
Comes forward to this full ball and drives it to the covers.
Length delivery going away off the seam, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Wide outside off, Joe reaches out and cuts it towards cover-point.
Cutting back in from a good length, worked in front of square leg for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Burns gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Uses his feet again and wrists it wide of Mendis at mid on. A quick run is stolen.
Tossed up delivery around off, defended by coming well forward.
From around the wicket, drifting in on middle and off, Head comes out of his crease and defends.
Dilruwan Perera is brought back on.
Takes a big stride forward to this one and pushes it towards the covers. End of the over.
On the fuller side of things, defended with the full face of the bat.
Back of a length outside off, the cut is slapped straight to cover.
Sprays it on the pads, flicked through the vacant square leg area. Big gap out there, so the batsmen are easily able to take two.
Length delivery just outside off, Burns plants his front foot forward and drives it in the bowler's direction.
No ball! Chamika again oversteps. Second of the over and the game. Shortish delivery in line of the stumps, worked in front of square leg for one more.
No ball! First of the game. The debutant oversteps as he bowls a length ball around off, Burns cuts it through the off side for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Burns slaps the cut to the cover fielder.
Chamika Karunaratne comes back on.
Short of a good length, angling in from around off, the southpaw rises on his toes and taps it down in front of covers.

FOUR! Beautifully played. There was a shout for catch it from the keeper but there never was a chance, played it all along the carpet. A little bit of width and Head cuts it across the third man boundary. Brings up the 100-run stand with that too.
In the off stump channel, on a length, Travis Head withdraws his bat and watches as the ball goes past him.
Extremely full and just outside off, drilled but straight to short extra cover.
Way wide outside off, Head doesn't even bother with it.
Good length delivery thrown across, Head opens the face and dabs it towards backward point.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Joe Burns. This has come in a streaky manner but he won't mind. Short ball and Joe looks to take the pull shot on. It goes off the top edge and over the keeper's head. 13 runs off the over. A big one for Australia.
FOUR! Intentional. Nicely controlled. Angling across, Burns just opens the face a little and runs it down to the third man fence.

Fifty for Travis Head, consecutive ones for him. 5th in this format. He taps this to the covers. Is a bit hesitant as the bowler attempts to get to the ball but can't. The batter takes off seeing that and completes the run. Well played.
Comes from wide of the crease and angles it a full ball on off stump, Head moves inside the line and works it to mid on.
Angling in from a good length, around off, blocked from the inner half to the left of the bowler.
FOUR! Head moves to 49. Good shot. He has some room on offer outside off, the southpaw cuts this behind point and finds the fence with ease.

FOUR! 5th Test fifty for Joe Burns and what a way to bring it up! Back of a length delivery outside off, Burns cuts it through cover-point and sends it across the boundary line. He's got his eye in and looks set. Will surely want to convert it into a big one. Perfect opportunity for him to do so given the conditions as well.
Fraction straight in line, slightly fuller in length, worked in front of mid-wicket.
Once again it's pitched outside off, a length ball, Joe watchfully lets it go.
In the channel outside off, Burns leaves it alone.
Shaping back in from a good length, defended from the crease towards mid on.
Full delivery on off stump, driven down the ground towards mid off.
Behind a good length, around off, it's defensively pushed towards mid off.
Bumper pounded in, Head ducks and evades.
Back of a length delivery and it is kept out safely.
FOUR! Shot. Not the length to be bowling on this kind of surface. Short ball which sits up for Head, he rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Angles in a length ball on off stump, Head leans inside and defends.
Length delivery around off, Head goes across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Around off, Burns plays it to the off side.
Pitches it up in search of swing. Not much on offer. Burns drives it to mid off.
Back of a length on leg, Burns tucks it away on the leg side. Dot ball.
Full again on off. Burns with soft hands taps it to the off side.
Slightly leave outside off. Another comfortable leave for the Aussie.
Length ball outside off, keeps going away from Burns who has an easy leave.
Pitches it up further on middle and off. Head blocks it in front of him.
Not too much wrong with this length ball on middle. Head stands tall and punches it through covers. Good fielding keeps it to two.
Good again. Comes in from over the wicket and gets in to come back to the southpaw. Head blocks it well.
This one is way outside off for Travis to play at it.
Good ball. Pitched up outside off. Head thinks of going for a drive with no feet movement but then watches it go through.
Good length ball on that off pole line. Head gets behind it and blocks it.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl from the other end.
Good length ball shaping away from Burns who leaves it alone.
Around off, Burns taps it towards point.
Goes even further on the pads. Burns looks to flick it but misses it. The ball hits his pads down leg. A stifled appeals dies down.
On that off stumps channel on a fuller length. Joe lets it through.
On a good length, in line of the stumps, Burns plays it with a straight bat towards mid on.
Some late swing. Fuller ball around off. Burns blocks it out to the off side.

We are back for the second session. Burns and Head will continue from where they left. The duo now know that they have seen out the tricky part and just need to spend time out there. Sri Lanka will hope to get the ball in the right areas and start this afternoon session like they did in the morning. Kasun Rajitha will bowl the first over for them post Lunch.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

Sri Lanka made the most of the morning session. When the ball was talking, they got the Australian top order to play at some and pegged them back at 28/3. Fernando with a brace and debutant Chamika Karunaratne got his maiden scalp. They had an opportunity to get Burns too later in the session but Dhananjaya didn't hold on to one. Overall a decent session for them. They will need to be patient come the afternoon session as the wicket will get better for batting. Join us in a bit for that.

The two left-handers in Harris and Khawaja threw their wickets away at the start. Labuschagne didn't last long either but Burns and Head have settled in quite well, the former in particular. The two have an unbeaten 75-run stand and will want to go on for as long as possible.
Good fightback from the Aussies. They have shown some application in the last hour and ensured their food gets digested a bit smoothly.
On the leg side, Head closes the face and defends it down safely. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 1.
Tossed up on middle, Head blocks it out.
Down the track again on off, Head gives it to mid on.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, again Head uses his feet but gives it back to the bowler.
Over the stumps, Head goes back and cuts it through cover-point. Enough to collect two.
Darts this full, Head comes down and pushes it to mid on.
Travis flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! These two are having plenty of time to pick their spot. Short ball on off, not much pace. Head pulls it in front of square through mid-wicket and earns another boundary to his name.
Good length ball outside off, Head leaves it alone.
Back of a length outside off, Head bunts it down towards the slip cordon.
Full on off, Head drives it to mid off.
Full on off, Burns goes for a drive but gets an inside edge towards backward square leg. They cross.
Fuller and well outside off, cut to the man at point.
Slider coming in on the pads, worked to the man at square leg.
Seeing the flight on it, Head steps out of his crease and blocks by getting close to the pitch.
Stays back and guards the spinning ball out safely.
Sliding in on leg, going further down, Head looks to flick but is caught on the pads.
FOUR! Comes down the track and takes it on the full. Head hits it neatly through mid-wicket and finds the fence. Australia getting a move on now, boundaries flowing for them.
FOUR! Second of the over. Another ball outside off, Burns waits for it and cuts this through point. The ball runs to the fence.
Joe shoulders arms to let that one through.
Outside off, Burns lets it go.
FOUR! Burns is really looking good. His eyes light up seeing the width as he cuts it through point for a boundary. Making up for a slow start.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a good length on off, Burns taps it in front of him.

DROPPED! You wait for an edge all day. When it comes you drop it. Ahhh! Too close to cut. Burns gets an outside edge to Dhananjaya at first slip. De Silva gets his hands to it but fails to hold on to it. The ball goes further to third man where they take three. Would have been perfect for the visitors to get a wicket just before Lunch.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, Perera gives room to Head who cuts it towards third man. They come back for the third to bring up the 50-run stand between these two.
Fuller ball in line of the stumps, Head gives it back to the bowler.
Head gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it out.
Outside off, fraction short. Head punches this through mid off and gets two for it.
This one is full on off, Burns drives but to the man at covers.
A bit fuller outside off, Burns points his bat skywards and lets it be.
Length closer to the stumps. Not enough for Burns to play at it.
Length outside off, Burns watchfully leaves it alone.
FOUR! He likes this shot very much. Short ball on off, Burns picks up the length quickly and dispatches this wide of mid on for a boundary.
On the pads of Head who flicks it away for a single.
Around off, Burns defends this from within his crease.
Travis has worked it off his pads behind square. One run added to the total.
Back of a length, Head tucks this one to square leg.
Back of a length ball into the body of Head. He misses his tuck to get hit high on the thigh pad.
Bouncer! Head ducks under it in time.
Outside off, not enough swing for Rajitha. Burns opens the bat face and guides it through gully for another single.
Around off, Head gets to the pitch of the ball and plays it towards mid on.
Quicker one spinning in, Head rocks back and punches this to mid off.
Down the leg side, flicked away towards square leg for one.
Burns stays back and punches it back to the bowler.
On off again, Burns gives it to the man at short leg on the bounce.
On off, Burns blocks it towards short leg.
Around off, Head punches it to the off side. The Aussies finally looking a little comfortable now.
Some swing for Kasun. Head flicks it away through square leg for a couple of runs.
Back of a length on the body of Head who bunts it down well.
Good length ball on the leg side, Head plays it towards mid-wicket.
On off, tapped to the off side.
On leg, worked away around the corner.
On the pads, Burns flicks it away with a wristy shot. The man at deep backward square leg dives and keeps it to two.
FOUR! An attacking shot from Burns and a good one. Tossed up ball on middle, Burns steps out of his crease and lofts this over mid on for a boundary.
In line of the stumps, Burns stonewalls it.
On the leg side, turned away around the corner.
Outside off, width on offer. Head cuts it but the man at point dives and saves runs for his side. Couldn't prevent the batsmen from taking one though.
A bit short on middle, jags back into the left-hander who plays it back to the bowler.
Dilruwan Perera to roll his arm over.
Joe Burns lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Good drive for nothing. Burns drives but finds the man at covers.
On the leg side, Joe tucks it away past backward square leg for a brace.
Similar channel just outside off, Burns this time sees it go through to the keeper.
Better from Rajitha. Good length ball on off, Burns feels for it but the ball beats his bat.

Nice balance from Burns. Overpitched on middle and leg, Burns flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder hares towards the ball and just stops it near the fence. The batsmen in the meantime, take four running runs.
Full and just outside off, Head drives it past mid off and gets a couple of runs for it.
FOUR! One of the few short balls Sri Lanka have bowled this morning. Head waits for it and punches it through cover-point for a boundary. The first runs after the break.
Around off, Head drives it to mid off. Dot ball.
Comes in from round the wicket and lands this outside off. Head is happy to leave it alone.
A bit short outside off, Head leaves it alone.
Good from Chamika. Angles this away from Head who shoulders his arms to it.
Maiden. In the off stump channel, Joe blocks it out.
Fuller this time in line of the stumps, squares Burns up. He gets an outside edge which falls short of the man at gully.
Closer to the stumps, Joe plays it with a straight bat towards mid off.
Outside off, Burns tries to run it down but gives it for the gully fielder to collect.
Short ball outside off, Burns goes for the pull and hits it straight to square leg.
On a good length on middle and leg, Burns taps it in front of him.

Drinks are on the field. Hands down Sri Lanka's hour. They have got off to the best start possible with three early wickets. Fernando bagged two dismissing Harris and Khawaja, while the debutant got his first Test in Labuschagne. The wicket gets better for batting later on, but there's still time left for that. Still some task left for the Australian middle order to do this morning. Also, Kasun Rajitha is back into the attack.
Places it just wide of the cover fielder and takes a single.
Drives this full ball and finds the man positioned at covers.

Gone right through! Burns is lucky that he hasn't dragged it back on or even hit the stumps directly. Comes back in sharply from a good length, from around off, Burns plays away from the body and it sneaks past the inside edge.
Angling in from around off, Joe comes half-forward and defends.
Moving away off the seam, a length ball around off, left alone.
FOUR! Shortish delivery well outside off, Burns sticks on the back foot, waits for it and plays it a little late as he cuts this through cover-point for a boundary.
This full delivery is driven to mid on by Head. The batsmen take two. That's the end of the over.
Outside off on a good length, no shot offered by the batter.

FOUR! Decent effort from the debutant out in the deep. Poor line from the bowler though and Head puts it away. The southpaw flicks it fine down the leg side as it's around leg. Chamika moves to his left, stops it first but goes over the rope with the momentum. Tries to stop it with a second attempt but fails in doing so. The replays confirm it. Boundary.
Well outside off, left alone by the batsman this time.
Coming in at first and then seaming away late, Head is a bit squared up as he opens the face and pats it towards point.
Goes full and attacks the off stump, driven towards short extra cover where skipper Chandimal dives to his left to stop it.
Full ball aiming the base of off stump, Burns gets behind the line and meets it with a defensive blade in response.
Brings it into the batsman, a good length delivery on off, it is blocked with the full face of the bat.
Wristed away square on the leg side. Head calls for it and steals a quick single.
On the sixth stump line, angling across, the left-hander has nothing to do with it.

FOUR! Nicely timed. Coming back in from a fuller length, on middle stump, Travis Head flicks it by leaning forward and finds the gap through mid-wicket. The fielder tries chasing it down but fails, even with the dive.
Hurls it full and just outside off, Head plays it with soft hands on the off side.
Cutting back in from a good length, tucked straight to the square leg fielder.
Same ball, around off, Burns once again thinks about taking the pull shot on but then doesn't at the last moment.
Bumper outside off, Burns initially winds up for the pull but then opts out of it.
Travis Head nudges it off the hips and places it behind square leg for a run. He's opened his account.
Angles it down the leg side, Head tries to tickle it fine but fails to do so.
Quite straight in line, Burns flicks it off the pads past that leg gully fielder for a single. The ploy is clear for him it seems.
A leg gully is in place for Joe Burns. Interesting.
Pitched too far outside off, easy leave for Head. A wonderful first over from Chamika Karunaratne comes to an end.
Angles it across on a good length, Head covers the line and shoulders arms.
Travis Head to bat next.

OUT! Edged and gone! First wicket in Test cricket for debutant Chamika Karunaratne. This is an encouraging start for him and Sri Lanka. Australia in a spot of bother here. This is a good delivery. Chamika keeps it in the off stump channel, on a length, Labuschagne has no choice but to play at it. The ball moves away late, induces the edge and Dickwella behind takes an easy catch diving to his right.
Back of a length around off, defended well.
