Close. This one nips back in, Labuschagne leaves as the ball whiskers past the off pole.
FOUR! Edged and away! Fuller length delivery outside off, slight movement away, Labuschagne is forward to play and gets a thick edge. It goes between the slip cordon and gully for a boundary.
Debutant Chamika Karunaratne is into the attack now.

A needless shy which leaks unnecessary runs. Burns flicks it to the fielder at square leg. Dimuth Karunaratne the man there. He throws it at the striker's end but misses. Nobody backing up and the batsmen take two.
A slip comes out and moves to square leg.
Too straight in line, goes off the pads as Burns looks to flick. No run taken.
Coming back in and angling down, the batter misses his flick.
Full delivery swinging back in, flicked straight to short leg. Seeing the batsman a step out of his crease, the fielder throws it at the striker's end but misses.
Wide outside off, the opener doesn't flirt with it, unlike his two fallen brothers.
FOUR! Puts that away. That's a good shot. Wide outside off, angling across, Joe Burns plants his front foot forward and cracks the drive through cover-point for a boundary.
Rajitha brings it in closer, around off, blocked watchfully.
Doing the sensible thing here. With the ball moving under overcast conditions, Labuschagne doesn't do anything silly. Makes another leave.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Easy leave. On a length outside off, left alone.
And Marnus is away in this Test match. He leans ahead to this full ball and drives it past point. A couple of runs taken.
Comfortably outside off, seaming away further, Labuschagne leaves it alone.
Angling across from a good length, left alone by Burns. End of another successful over from Fernando, who has picked up his second wicket of the innings in this over.
Cutting back in from a good length, very close to off and it cramps Burns for room. He still manages to force it down in front of covers.

Shout for a leg before, turned down. Pitching outside leg probably, missing the leg stump too from the looks of it. Length delivery coming back in, catches Labuschagne on the pads as he misses his flick. It rolls away on the leg side as the batsmen take a leg bye.
Marnus Labuschagne is the next batsman in.

OUT! Sri Lanka are off a great start here. Second wicket down already and it's of the solid Usman Khawaja. A poor shot, really. Maybe a lapse in concentration. Full and well outside off, swinging away, Khawaja plays well away from his body without any foot movement. It goes off the edge and flies to Kusal Mendis at second slip who takes a safe catch.
The batsman has played it to the point region. No run taken.
Serves it on the sixth stump line, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Back of a length delivery around off, firmly blocked into the off side.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Joe has nothing to do with that.
Late movement away after angling in, a length ball on off, Burns opens the face and dabs it in front of point.
Length delivery on off, blocked with a straight bat.
FOUR! Sweet timing from Joe Burns. Just leans into the drive and caresses it through the covers. Was a little too full outside off, which helped the opener get close to the pitch and find the gap.
Beauty from Rajitha! Yikes... Joe Burns barely survives. This is bowled around off, on a length and it moves away late. Burns plays at it and almost nicks it behind. The line almost undid him.
Usman Khawaja walks in at no.3.

OUT! One shot too many. Harris departs and that's an early breakthrough for Sri Lanka. Fernando celebrates, along with his teammates. Full and wide outside off, shapes away further, Harris reaches out to it unnecessarily and hands a sharp catch to debutant Chamika Karunaratne at point.
Works this off his hips down towards fine leg. Harris runs the first one hard and calls for the second. Completes it with ease too.

FOUR! Cuts and cuts hard... first boundary of the day for Harris and Australia. Width offered outside off, the left-hander throws everything at it. Gets it over the slip cordon and away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Nice shape on this, a good length ball around off, it's played off the outer half to point.
Full delivery wide outside off, driven to the man at covers.
Angling in at first, but then straightening up a shade as it lands around off. Harris is on the back foot as he defends.
Back of a length quite close to off, Joe Burns stays right behind the line and blocks it out.
Pitches it full and down leg, a flick and a miss from the right-hander.
Too far outside off to make the batsman play, it's left alone.
Leaving the batsman, from a fullish length around off, Joe comes ahead and meets it with the full face.
On the fifth stump line, Burns covers the line, raises his bat skywards and lets it go.
First ball of the day for Joe Burns. He stays inside his crease and defensively pushes the outswinging full ball outside off to covers.
Makes the batsman play. Fernando bowls it full and keeps it around off, it swings away late as Marcus defends off the front foot.
Full ball, well outside off, comfortably let through to the keeper.
Short of a good length with room on offer outside off, Harris cuts but can't get it past point.
Three in a row. Hurled too far outside off, the southpaw shoulders arms to it.
Landed on a good length in the channel outside off, moves away again, Marcus Harris makes another leave.
Shaping away from around off, on a good length, Harris lets it be.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl from the other end.
Low full toss on off, Harris plays it with a straight bat through to mid off. It doesn't go all the way but enough to come back for the third.
On a good length around off, Harris defends the ball off his back foot.
Full again on middle and leg. Harris plays it towards mid-wicket.
Australia are off the mark. Fuller ball in line of the stumps. Harris flicks it away through mid-wicket and comes back for a brace.
Some swing for Kasun. So a good sign for them. He however, serves another one down leg. It flicks off the pads and goes to the keeper. The cordon was excited for sometime.
Not the ideal start for Sri Lanka. Rajitha comes in from over the wicket and lands it way down the leg side. Harris leaves it alone.

The Sri Lankan players have made their way out after a team huddle. The Australian openers, Joe Burns and Marcus Harris, will take center stage in a Test debut for the Manuka Oval. Kasun Rajitha will bowl the first over of the match. Three slips in place. Let's play!!!

TEAM CHANGES - As already announced, Australia are going in with the same XI. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, have four changes - Lahiru Kumara, Roshen Silva, Dushmantha Chameera and Suranga Lakmal miss out due to injuries and Kusal Perera, Vishwa Fernando, Kasun Rajitha and Chamika Karunaratne (debut) replace them.
TOSS - Australia win the toss and elect to bat first!

A momentous occasion as the Manuka Oval hosts it first-ever Test match. This is the perfect chance for a hopeful Australian side to win their first Test series since the Sandpaper Gate. They are going to most likely face a depleted Sri Lankan side and with Suranga Lakmal's availability in doubt, there's a good chance the visitors will place an inexperience bowling attack. In the first game, the hosts steamrolled the Lions, handing them an innings defeat. They will field an unchanged XI, while the touring side will have plenty of changes owing to several injuries. Will some of the key players step up for them and finally win a Test match in Australia? Or will the Tim Paine-led side finish off the Australian summer in fine style? We shall find out. Welcome to what we and everyone hopes will be a competitive battle at the very least.
